why: A service name swap that the entity extractor misses on purpose: adding '-' to the identifier signal would make every hyphenated English word an entity and reject paraphrases like 'read-only'/'read only'. Measured at 0.7423, so tau refuses it -- recorded here so the limitation is a measured tradeoff rather than an unnoticed hole.
